tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.resonator_m: Install in a Low-Frequency Resonator socket (3 slots). Sneak and use the resonator while idle to open the console.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.range_coil: Each coil adds 512 blocks of range (base 512 omnidirectional, up to 3 coils). Longer range also lengthens the listening cooldown.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.directional: Enables aimed mode. 1 matrix: 48° cone and 2560 range. 2: 32° and 4608. 3: 20° and 6656. Range coils still add 512 each on top.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.cycle_regul: Each regulator adds 24 blocks/s to pulse speed. Cooldown is the listening window, so the ping returns sooner.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.harmonic_de: One only. Discovered sites ping with their true color and name; muted sites disappear from the pulse.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.harmonic_ke: One only. It tunes the pulse to the Timeless Portal's frequency, so the Resonator can hear Time Recolector's crypt.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.pedestal_me: Its sealed memory floats above the pedestal
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.petrified_p: Petrification is permanent; this creature cannot be restored.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.petrified_m: The head was struck off. Silk Touch would have kept the statue whole.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.medusa_gaze: Hold to unleash a chaotic gaze that turns anything it sees to stone — players and bosses included. Players die instantly and leave a statue behind.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.medusa_petr: Hold to unleash a brittle stone gaze. Players still fall, but bosses shrug it off.
Five durability — each successful channel chips the stone, not each statue.
tooltip.echoes_show_the_past.medusa_pump: A carved pumpkin on the head is the only ward. Not balanced for PvP; meant for fun.
lore.echoes_show_the_past.eye_of_horus: A modern echo of an ancient protective symbol; no miracle is claimed.
